summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited Bitcoin production and mining operations update for June 2026. The filing discloses 64 BTC mined during the month, total cryptocurrency holdings of 1,915 BTC and 3,952 ETH, and operational metrics including hash rate and power costs. It also provides commentary on joint venture recovery with WindHQ after wildfire disruptions and general business strategy. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation event. No transaction, corporate action, or material definitive agreement is announced; the filing simply reports monthly operational results.
